dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, do you need a hand with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Sobolev
dialogues.text: Funny you should ask. I've got a shipment that needs to be loaded up and sent off to Snezhnograd soon. Problem is, three people from the escort team still haven't shown up.

dialogues.speaker: Sobolev
dialogues.text: We could probably manage without the three of them, but if anything goes wrong on the road and we suddenly find ourselves short-handed, that'll be a real headache.

dialogues.speaker: Sobolev
dialogues.text: My guess is those fools got the date wrong, and they're probably still down below with their heads buried in work. Sorry to trouble you, but could you make a trip over to their work area and look for them?
